title: Model access and routes were clarified
summary:
Model access, routing, and request queues got a careful tune-up, while Kontext and community projects gave people more to build with.

Anonymous model access was corrected, then text routes and model labels were updated through the week. By July 4, `openai-large` routed to GPT-4.1, `openai` to GPT-4o mini, and `openai-fast` and `openai-roblox` to GPT-4.1 nano. Bidara moved to anonymous access; GPT Image was marked as requiring flower tier. Text requests also gained distinct errors for insufficient access and unknown models.

Image requests made with a token are no longer limited to one at a time. Shared queues now apply concurrency caps across text and image requests: three for seed, ten for flower, and thirty for nectar. Anonymous requests remain capped at one. Token and referrer lookup caching, along with token-validation caching, reduces repeated lookups.

The new `kontext` model generates voxel art from a text prompt or input image at seed tier and above, with a 640-pixel maximum side length. Site examples now show the reference-image URL format. Image semantic-cache matching was tightened, and tools for examining image-to-image inputs and outputs were added.

API docs gained clearer endpoint navigation and examples for vision, speech, function calling, and other multimodal requests. Invalid authentication tokens now produce an error rather than falling through to another method. Authenticated nex.ad requests no longer include the user's IP or fire impression URLs, and the sign-in page was reworked for smaller screens.
